LanguageData.HD_StarterSupply_Summary: A supply caravan is scheduled one day after the pioneers settle. Blocked arrivals are retried.
LanguageData.HD_StarterSupply_Arrived: The pioneer supply caravan has arrived with steel and basic industrial materials.
LanguageData.HD_StarterSupply_Delayed: The supply caravan is delayed by access, weather or diplomatic conditions. It will keep trying to reach a friendly player settlement.
